purpose: One frozen explicit record-portability batch. Settings exports this device's private memo snapshot as text and JSON; an archive record exports its validated JPEG copy and memo, or memo-only when its photo is missing. Conflict and pending-deletion records cannot be exported. Archive generation rechecks the account and complete record revision; account changes invalidate preparation and the share sheet. The user chooses a destination in the real system sheet; cancellation preserves source records and cleans temporary files. No automatic upload, record mutation, original-photo guarantee or purchase gate is introduced. Existing export/store/account Swift verifiers, app and extension Build and existing signature checks, privacy checks, Photos permission/scan and sharing runtime on both iOS versions remain required. Two native operations check system-sheet arrival, cancellation, source retention and cleanup. Widget rendering/selection, PBX and server sources are unchanged; Gallery is excluded by the existing mechanical guard. Native rendering and system-sheet cancellation have not yet been executed for this candidate. This scope is unmeasured and this manifest is not successful CI or TestFlight evidence.
